tokoh_utama: A 22-year-old Indonesian young man, wearing a plain black t-shirt, messy short black hair, anxious expression, medium brown skin.

part.pertanyaan: Kalau kamu jadi aku, kamu angkat telepon dari Ayah atau nurut surat itu?
part.caption: Membuka surat kapsul waktu 5 tahun lalu, tapi malah nemu ramalan kematian dan kejadian aneh minggu ini...

adegan.narasi: Lima tahun lalu aku nulis surat kapsul waktu buat diriku sendiri.
adegan.gambar: A young man sitting at a wooden desk in a dimly lit bedroom, writing on a piece of paper with a pen under warm yellow lamplight.

adegan.narasi: Amplop cokelat kusam itu aku simpan rapat di dalam laci kamar.
adegan.gambar: Close-up of a dusty vintage brown paper envelope stored inside a dark wooden drawer.

adegan.narasi: Hari ini aku membukanya, berharap nemu kenangan manis masa SMA dulu.
adegan.gambar: The young man opening the old brown envelope with curious and nostalgic expression.

adegan.narasi: Isinya memang mimpi konyol, tapi ada daftar aneh di bagian bawah.
adegan.gambar: Over-the-shoulder shot showing a yellowed paper filled with childish handwriting and a strange list handwritten at the bottom.

adegan.narasi: Tulisan tangan itu mirip milikku, "Senin, kucing tetangga mati di pagar."
adegan.gambar: Extreme close-up of handwritten text on paper reading an unsettling note in Indonesian handwriting style.

adegan.narasi: Aku merinding karena persis hari Senin kemarin kejadian itu beneran terjadi.
adegan.gambar: Point of view looking out a front house gate at night, a lifeless black cat lying near the fence in dark atmosphere.

adegan.narasi: Baris kedua tertulis jelas, "Selasa malam, bohlam dapur bakal mendadak pecah."
adegan.gambar: Close-up of the second line of handwriting on the paper, shaky handwriting with dark ink.

adegan.narasi: Kemarin malam bohlam dapur rumahku memang meledak berkeping-keping tanpa sebab.
adegan.gambar: A dimly lit kitchen where a light bulb overhead suddenly shatters with sparks falling to the ground.

adegan.narasi: Aku mulai panik karena sama sekali tidak ingat pernah menulis prediksi itu.
adegan.gambar: The young man staring at the paper in shock, wide pale eyes, sweat on forehead.

adegan.narasi: Aku memegang kertas itu erat-erat dengan perasaan makin tidak enak.
adegan.gambar: The young man holding the paper with both hands in front of him. On the wall behind him, a dark eerie shadow of a hand holding a quill pen is cast clearly, even though no one is holding a pen.

adegan.narasi: Jantungku berdebar kencang saat mataku menatap baris ketiga tulisan tangan tersebut.
adegan.gambar: Close-up of the young man's nervous trembling hand gripping the corner of the aged paper.

adegan.narasi: Di sana tertulis tegas, "Rabu, jangan pernah angkat telepon dari Ayah."
adegan.gambar: Close-up on the paper revealing the terrifying bold line of handwriting warning not to answer Dad's phone call.

part.pertanyaan: Menurut kalian, siapa yang menulis lanjutan surat itu?
part.caption: Ayahku sudah lama meninggal, tapi Rabu malam kontak 'Ayah' mendadak menelepon HP-ku...

adegan.narasi: Lanjutan surat itu bikin aku syok karena Ayahku sudah meninggal lama.
adegan.gambar: Lanjutan part 1. The young man looking terrified in his dark bedroom, holding the letter with trembling hands.

adegan.narasi: Mana mungkin Ayah yang sudah tiada tiba-tiba bisa menelepon HP milikku.
adegan.gambar: A framed old photograph of a father and son sitting on a side table in the dimly lit bedroom.

adegan.narasi: Rabu malam suasana rumah mendadak dingin dan kipas angin terhenti sendiri.
adegan.gambar: A standing electric fan in the bedroom slowly coming to a complete stop, shadows stretching cold across the floor.

adegan.narasi: Tepat jam dua belas malam, layar HP milikku menyala di meja.
adegan.gambar: A smartphone resting on a dark nightstand suddenly illuminating bright blue light in the dark room.

adegan.narasi: Kontak nama "Ayah" muncul di layar telepon yang terus berdering nyaring.
adegan.gambar: Close-up of the smartphone screen displaying incoming call from contact named 'Ayah' with incoming call UI active.

adegan.narasi: Telepon itu berdering sampai tiga puluh kali tanpa henti dalam kegelapan.
adegan.gambar: Wide shot of the dark bedroom with the smartphone glowing brightly, vibrating intensely on the desk.

adegan.narasi: Mengingat peringatan di surat, aku cuma bisa terdiam menahan napas takut.
adegan.gambar: The young man curled up on his bed, covering his mouth in pure horror, refusing to reach for the phone.

adegan.narasi: Panggilan itu akhirnya terputus, tapi notifikasi pesan suara baru langsung masuk.
adegan.gambar: Smartphone screen showing the call ended, instantly followed by a pop-up banner: 'New Voicemail Received'.

adegan.narasi: Tanganku gemetaran membuka pesan suara itu sambil memandang ke luar jendela.
adegan.gambar: The young man tapping the phone screen near the bedroom window. Outside the dark window glass behind him, a pale tall uncanny silhouette with faint white eyes is staring inside.

adegan.narasi: Dari speaker HP-ku, terdengar jelas suara berat khas milik almarhum Ayah.
adegan.gambar: Extreme close-up of the smartphone speaker with audio wave animation active on screen.

adegan.narasi: Suara Ayah berbisik, "Kenapa kamu nurutin surat itu? Yang nulis bukan kamu."
adegan.gambar: The young man staring in absolute terror at his phone, jaw dropped, pale face in blue screen light.

adegan.narasi: Tubuhku langsung membeku kaku mendengar peringatan mengerikan dari pesan suara itu.
adegan.gambar: Overhead shot of the young man sitting frozen on his bed, isolated in a dark cold room.

part.pertanyaan: Kalau handle pintu rumahmu mendadak bergerak sendiri, apa yang bakal kamu lakukan?
part.caption: Surat itu menulis sendiri kalimat baru di depan mataku! Dan sekarang ada ketukan di pintu...

adegan.narasi: Lanjutan pesan suara Ayah membuatku panik dan langsung mengambil surat itu.
adegan.gambar: Lanjutan part 2. The young man frantically snatching the mysterious letter back off the desk.

adegan.narasi: Aku periksa lembaran surat itu lagi dengan penerangan lampu kamar remang.
adegan.gambar: Close-up of the paper under dim yellow lamp light, showing the bottom lines of writing.

adegan.narasi: Tulisan di bagian bawah ternyata bertambah dan tintanya masih terlihat basah.
adegan.gambar: Macro shot of fresh, glossy black ink glistening on the surface of the paper.

adegan.narasi: Di depan mataku sendiri, goresan tinta hitam muncul membentuk kalimat baru.
adegan.gambar: Paper magically forming black ink strokes on its own as if written by an invisible hand.

adegan.narasi: Surat itu menulis sendiri secara perlahan, "Kamis, buka pintu untuk Ayah."
adegan.gambar: Close-up of the newly formed line reading 'Kamis, buka pintu untuk Ayah' written in fresh wet ink.

adegan.narasi: Tiba-tiba terdengar ketukan keras dari balik pintu depan rumahku yang sepi.
adegan.gambar: The front door of the house seen from a dark living room hallway, illuminated by faint street light.

adegan.narasi: Aku berjalan pelan mendekati pintu sambil menggenggam erat kertas ramalan itu.
adegan.gambar: The young man walking slowly down the dark hallway toward the front door holding the paper. In the dark corner behind a pillar, a distorted shadow figure with an unnaturally wide pale smile lurks silently.

adegan.narasi: Suara dari balik pintu memanggil lembut, Ayah berkata, "Nak, buka pintunya."
adegan.gambar: Close-up of the wooden front door surface, dark shadows lingering on the outside.

adegan.narasi: Tapi saat mataku melihat celah bawah pintu, tidak ada bayangan kaki manusia.
adegan.gambar: Low angle close-up looking at the narrow gap under the front door, revealing complete emptiness and dark mist on the outside threshold.

adegan.narasi: Surat di tanganku mendadak berubah tulisan, "Jangan buka, yang di balik pintu bukan Ayah."
adegan.gambar: Close-up of the paper in hand where text rapidly morphs into terrifying warning in red-tinged ink.

adegan.narasi: Jadi siapa sosok yang berdiri di luar dan siapa pembuat surat ini?
adegan.gambar: The young man taking a step back in pure shock, horror reflected in his wide eyes.

adegan.narasi: Handle pintu depan mulai bergerak turun perlahan dari luar ruangan.
adegan.gambar: Extreme close-up of the metal front door handle slowly clicking and turning downward by itself.
